public_file_policy: No secret values, private advisory text, or private advisory IDs. Private repository advisories use sanitized IDs; raw reports stay in gitignored build/eng-artifacts/T1/.

categories.application: default-build first-party code (C backend, tools, web UI) and project advisories
categories.optional-feature: first-party code compiled only behind a CMake feature option (feature_flag names it)
categories.build-only: development/lint/test/build dependencies not shipped in the production bundle or image
categories.container: OS/language packages inside the published container image

dispositions.needs-triage: open, unreviewed; no exception granted (exception_expiry null). T7 maps to remediation or a reviewed exception.
dispositions.baseline-debt: low-severity quality debt accepted as current baseline pending T7/T6 policy; proposed expiry must be confirmed by maintainers
dispositions.exception-dismissed-false-positive: dismissed upstream; T1 proposes an expiry because none is recorded
dispositions.fixed-upstream-verify-regression: published advisory affecting earlier releases; needs regression evidence only
dispositions.informational: tool diagnostics about analysis coverage, not code findings

coverage_gaps.summary: Secret scanning, non-provider patterns, validity checks and push protection are disabled; alerts API returns HTTP 404. No secret-scan baseline exists (not a clean result).
codeql-analysis.yml triggers on push to main, weekly schedule and dispatch only; SECURITY.md claims CodeQL runs on every PR.
No security SAST for web JS/TS (CodeQL matrix is c-cpp only; default setup not-configured). Only GitHub Code Quality (maintainability) inspects web JS. Actions/Python also unscanned.
coverage_gaps.evidence: codeql-analysis.yml matrix; GET code-scanning/default-setup -> state not-configured

coverage_gaps.summary: All scanners are report-only: clang-tidy forced exit 0, cppcheck --error-exitcode=0, trivy --exit-code 0, jsx-a11y rules are warn; branch protection on main has no required status checks; CodeQL upload is not a gate.
coverage_gaps.evidence: static-analysis.yml, container-scan.yml, web/eslint.config.js, GET branches/main/protection (required_status_checks null)

coverage_gaps.summary: CodeQL and clang-tidy compile with ENABLE_SOD=OFF ENABLE_GO2RTC=OFF BUILD_TESTS=OFF; LiteRT (submodule not checked out), Sentry and SSL are also off. go2rtc integration sources are therefore not analyzed by CodeQL; 9 dismissed go2rtc_api.c alerts (#19,#20,#69-#71,#75-#78) are unobservable rather than resolved. MQTT/S3 are analyzed only because the full profile enables them by default.
coverage_gaps.evidence: workflow cmake flags; CMakeLists.txt options; dismissed alerts with last instance at d123e2f3

coverage_gaps.summary: cppcheck runs without compile database/defines: 'information' entries (missingInclude, checkLevelNormal, toomanyconfigs) show partial analysis; third-party src/sod is included while clang-tidy excludes it.
jsx-a11y lint output exists only in the job log (stylish format); no machine-readable artifact is uploaded. Issue #647 (WCAG audit) is CLOSED while 897 warnings remain.
coverage_gaps.evidence: static-analysis.yml web-jsx-a11y job; job 124465163606 log; gh issue view 647

coverage_gaps.summary: Trivy scans only the linux/amd64 image built from Dockerfile, CRITICAL/HIGH/MEDIUM only, on push/tags (not PRs). arm64/arm-v7 published images, Dockerfile.alpine and the sentry image are not scanned. Raw artifact upload is skipped if the SARIF step fails.
coverage_gaps.evidence: container-scan.yml; docker-publish.yml has no scan step

coverage_gaps.summary: No .github/dependabot.yml: Dependabot security alerts cover only npm manifests (package.json, package-lock.json, web/package-lock.json). GitHub Actions, go2rtc Go modules (submodule) and Docker base images rely solely on Trivy image scanning. Dependabot lagged npm audit by two advisories published 2026-10-30.
coverage_gaps.evidence: GET dependabot/alerts manifest_path histogram; npm audit vs Dependabot reconciliation

coverage_gaps.summary: No CODEOWNERS file; finding owners are recorded as maintainers/<area> placeholders until assigned.
